footprints.description: Same Sky TS41 SMD tactile switch, 4.5 x 3.3 mm, 3 terminals drawn as a 2-terminal switch (pin 1 = the two common terminals)
footprints.note: ts41.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB Layout, top view: three terminal pads 0.9 x 1.7, outer 3.5, so centres at -1.3 / 0 / +1.3 (0.4 gaps); the layout labels them 3-2-1 left to right, the front view 1-2-3; schematic p.2: 1 and 3 are one common terminal switching to 2, so per plan-27-B Correction 3 this is a 2-terminal switch with TWO pads for pin 1 (terminals 1 and 3, the outer pads; the 1/3 label conflict does not matter) and one pad for pin 2 (centre); the two 0.6-high cover-tab lands (4.9 / 2.6, 1.35 above the terminal pads) and the two peg slots (4.3 apart) left out; body 4.5 x 3.3 (4.5+-0.2, 3.3) with the terminals leaving its bottom edge (3.9 to the lead toes, so toes 0.6 past the body); the drawing gives no direct pad-to-body dimension: pads placed with their outer edge 0.35 past the lead toe (pad centres y=+1.75), body position against the pads estimated (+-0.4); pads relative to each other exact
